sources.label: Morphe Patches
sources.author: JoFSlash
patch_list: AMOLED dark mode
Uses a pure black background when Quora's dark theme is on.
Answer font
Sets answers in a serif or a sans-serif font of your phone.
Block advertising ID
Stops the app from sending your advertising ID and Android ID to Quora.
Block app telemetry
Stops the app from sending usage logs to Quora, such as reading time, tab presses, experiments, app speed and errors.
Block authors and Spaces
Hides answers and posts by the people and Spaces you pick. Long-press a name in the feed to add it.
Block Branch tracking
Turns on Branch's "disable tracking" mode and turns off its debug mode. Branch tracks where installs come from. Quora's quora.app.link links may open with less detail.
Block clipboard reading
Stops Quora's pages from reading what you copied. Pasting with the keyboard still works.
Block promotional notifications
Drops digest and promotional push notifications. Replies, comments and other notifications about you still arrive.
Block tracking logs
Stops Quora's pages from passing performance and sign-up tracking events to the app.
Block web trackers
Blocks requests from Quora pages to third-party analytics and tracking services.
Bookmarks

Adds a bookmark button next to Share under an open answer or post, to read it later. Saved items are listed under Bookmarks in Patch settings with their text and pictures, which you can read without internet. Everything stays on your phone.
Clean shared links
Removes tracking parameters from Quora links you copy or share.
Clone app
Changes the package name, so the patched app installs next to the official Quora app instead of replacing it. Both apps keep their own login and data. Sharing to Facebook may not work in the clone.
Comfortable reading
More space between the lines and paragraphs of answers.
Copy answer text
Adds a Copy button next to Share under answers and posts. It copies their text without formatting.
Data saver
Images load only when you tap them. By default only on mobile data; on Wi-Fi they load as usual.
Disable analytics
Turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Firebase Performance and Facebook app events, and their advertising ID collection.
Disable notification prompt
Stops the app from asking to show notifications, both its own prompt and Android's. You can still turn notifications on in Android's settings.
Disable rating prompts
Stops the app from asking you to rate it on Google Play.
Disable sign-in prompts
Stops Google's "Save password?" and automatic Google sign-in prompts. You can still sign in with the buttons on the login page.
Disable swipe gestures
Turns off pulling down to refresh and swiping sideways between feeds, so a page doesn't reload or change while you read.
Disable tab prefetching
Saves data by loading the other tabs only when you open them.
Disable tracking jobs
Stops the background jobs that tell Quora every hour whether your phone is charging and every day whether notifications are on.
Disable update prompts
Stops the app from showing the Google Play update screen and the feed's update card.
Disable vibration
Stops the app from vibrating when you tap buttons such as upvote.
Disable video autoplay
Videos in the feed and in answers only play when you tap them.
Disable WebView debugging
Stops the app from letting a connected computer inspect its pages, which would show your account's cookies.
Enable text selection
Lets you select and copy text on every page.
Expand answers
Opens shortened answers on question pages, and shows the whole answer preview in the feed.
Filter keywords
Hides answers, posts and questions that mention words you pick.
Filter updates

When Quora renames what a patch hides, fixes come without a new release: once a day the app downloads a small list of selectors from this project's GitHub repository and uses it for the patches you have on. The list can only hide things. T…
Fix device theme
On a new install, follows the device's dark or light theme everywhere. Without it, Quora shows dark bars around light pages until you pick a theme again.
Fix push notifications
Makes push notifications work in the patched app. Quora's Firebase key only accepts the official app's package and signature, so a patched app never gets a push token.
Fullscreen reading
Hides the top bar and the tabs while you scroll down, and shows them again when you scroll up. On answer and question pages it hides their top bar.
GmsCore support

Makes Google sign-in and push notifications work through MicroG-RE instead of Google Play services. A patched app can't sign in with Google through Play services, because it is no longer signed by Quora. Needs MicroG-RE installed, with you…
Hide AI answers
Hides answers written by Poe bots.
Hide anonymous answers
Hides answers written as "Anonymous" in the feed and on question pages.
Hide ask box
Hides the "What do you want to ask or share?" box with Ask, Answer and Post at the top of the feed.
Hide Ask button
Hides the button for asking a question in the top bar and on pages.
Hide badges
Hides the red dots and counts on the bottom bar tabs.
Hide comment box
Hides the "Add a comment…" field under answers and posts. Comments still open from the comment button.
Hide comment previews
Hides the "123 comments from … and more" row under answers. Comments still open from the comment button.
Hide counts
Hides upvote, view and share counts on answers and posts.
Hide credentials
Hides the line under authors' names, such as "Lives in Vienna", and "Upvoted by" lines. The date stays.
Hide dismissed questions

When you close a feed item with its × and pick "Not interested in this question", the feed doesn't show answers to that question again. Undo brings it back. The list stays on your phone, under Dismissed questions in Patch settings.
Hide downvote button
Hides the downvote button on answers and posts.
Hide Follow buttons
Hides the small "Follow" next to author and Space names. Profiles and Space pages keep theirs.
Hide low-voted answers
Hides answers and posts with fewer upvotes than the number you pick, in the feed and on question pages.
Hide machine-translated answers
Hides answers and posts that Quora marks as translated from another language.
Hide More Stories button
Hides the red "More Stories" button that appears over the feed. Pull down to load new stories.
Hide old answers
Hides answers and posts older than the number of years you pick, in the feed and on question pages.
Hide people suggestions
Hides "People you may know" and other people to follow in the feed.
Hide picture and video posts
Hides answers and posts in the feed that are only a picture or a video, with hardly any text.
Hide Poe
Hides links and buttons that open Poe or Quora's AI assistant.
Hide Quora+ answers
Hides answers and posts that show only their start, with a Quora+ lock over the rest.
Hide Quora+ promotions
Hides buttons that ask you to try or join Quora+.
Hide related questions
Hides the related questions lists on question pages.
Hide reshares
Hides answers and posts in the feed that someone only shared again.
Hide seen items
Dims or hides feed items you already opened when the feed shows them again. The list of opened items stays on your phone.
Hide Spaces posts
Hides posts from Spaces in the feed, so it shows answers to questions only.
Hide Spaces suggestions
Hides the Spaces you might like suggestions in the feed.
Hide suggested questions
Hides the questions for you to answer in the feed.
Hide surveys
Hides Quora's surveys in the feed, such as "How satisfied are you with your home feed?" and "Was this worth your time?" under answers.
Hide tabs
Removes the tabs you pick from the bottom bar. Home always stays.
Hide what you pick
Patch settings > More > Pick something to hide: tap a box on the page to hide it and every box like it. Filters lists what you picked, to show it again.
Keep place on return
Keeps open answers and your place in the feed when you come back to the app, instead of closing them and reloading the feed.
Keep screen on
Keeps the screen from turning off while a page is open.
Open links in browser
Opens links to other websites in your default browser instead of an in-app browser tab.
Patch settings

Long-press the Home tab, or open Settings > Morphe > Quora patches, to switch the page patches on and off and edit the filters, without patching again. It also tells you when Quora changes its pages so that some patches stop working, and h…
Read aloud
Adds a Read aloud button next to Share under answers and posts. It reads their text with your phone's text-to-speech. Tap it again to stop.
Reader view
Adds a Reader view button next to Share under answers and posts. It shows their text with the pictures in a plain page, without the rest of Quora's page.
Reading history
Remembers the answers, posts and questions you open, so you can find them again under History in Patch settings. The list stays on your phone.
Reading time
Shows how many minutes an open answer or post takes to read, when it takes at least two.
Remove ads
Hides promoted answers, sponsored posts and Google ads in the feed and on question pages, and blocks requests to ad servers.
Save images
Long-press an image you opened full screen to save it to Pictures/Quora.
Share answer text
Adds a Share text button next to Share under answers and posts. It shares their text without formatting, for example to a notes app.
Sort answers
Opens questions with their answers sorted by the order you pick instead of Recommended. You can still change the order on the page.
Spoof installer
Reports Google Play as the app installer, so Quora does not treat the patched app as installed from an unknown source.
Start tab
Opens the app on the tab you pick instead of Home.
Text size
Makes the text on every page larger or smaller.
Translate button

Adds a Translate button next to Share under answers and posts. It shows their text translated by Google Translate inside the app, into your phone's language or the one you pick. The text is sent to Google only when you tap the button.
Update notice

Shows in Patch settings when newer patches are out, since a patched app doesn't update from Google Play: once a day the app reads the newest version number from this project's GitHub repository. Nothing pops up. The check sends nothing but…
Word count
Shows how many words and characters you have written while you write an answer or a post.
